title: Wealth Is What You Don't See
coreMove: Train yourself to respect invisible reserves more than visible spending.
sourcePressure: Real wealth is unspent optionality, but outsiders mostly see income and consumption.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Equating wealth with high income or impressive possessions.

hook: opening with a generic paycheck scene
opening with a moral lesson about discipline
opening Wealth Is What You Don't See with a swapped-in personal finance anecdote
counterintuition: reducing Wealth Is What You Don't See to common-sense advice
tryThisNow: write down your values for ninety seconds
asking for a generic money reflection instead of the invisible wealth move
examples: reusing visible anchors from adjacent chapters instead of invisible wealth and savings

exampleSpecs.domain: a shipyard welder with old coveralls and a large unseen emergency fund
exampleSpecs.audience: a young apprentice learning that visible spending is not wealth
exampleSpecs.stakes: copying the flashiest worker may keep him broke
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the apprentice notices the quiet welder can walk away from a bad contract because of savings nobody can see
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a payroll office hallway with worn coveralls beside a signed refusal form

exampleSpecs.domain: a boutique fitness instructor earning well but saving little
exampleSpecs.audience: a coach whose public lifestyle hides fragility
exampleSpecs.stakes: followers may mistake display for stability
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she compares the rented launch-party backdrop with the unpaid quarterly tax bill
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a studio mirror reflecting a balloon arch after the party

exampleSpecs.domain: a family deciding whether to replace a paid-off minivan that embarrasses their teenager
exampleSpecs.audience: parents teaching invisible optionality without lecturing
exampleSpecs.stakes: a car payment would consume the reserve that lets them handle job loss
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they show the teen the payment amount as months of rent the old van preserves
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a dealership brochure folded beside the old van title

exampleSpecs.domain: a museum conservator choosing storage improvements visitors never see
exampleSpecs.audience: a director defending invisible protection over a flashy exhibit
exampleSpecs.stakes: the collection's real wealth is preserved in climate control, not applause
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she funds humidity control after comparing visitor donations with mold risk
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a humidity sensor blinking inside a quiet storage room

exampleSpecs.domain: a pro athlete's cousin comparing entourages at draft night
exampleSpecs.audience: a family member tempted to judge who is richest by who spends first
exampleSpecs.stakes: early visible spending can hide a shrinking runway
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after two seasons, he lines up the houses bought with the accounts that still have cash
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a draft-night photo album next to a private balance sheet

exampleSpecs.domain: a small bakery keeping a plain storefront while owning its ovens outright
exampleSpecs.audience: a customer assuming the flashy competitor is doing better
exampleSpecs.stakes: visible polish can mask debt while plain ownership creates resilience
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner points to the paid-off oven tag when a supplier offers risky expansion credit
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a flour-dusted oven plate stamped paid in full
